title: SubmitIncidentRequest represents the incident submitted by a contributor

task_id.description:
Optional. The unique identifier of the incident
If not provided, UUID will be generated server side

title.description:
Required. Title of the incident
Title is limited to only 255 characters max

created_at.description: Optional. Date and time this incident was created

category_id.description:
Required. ID of the incident's category
If not set, this incident will be stored with the default category(None)

answered_questions.description:
Optional. An array of all, if any, custom questions that have been answered
by the contributor
@deprecated: Use `QuestionAnswer` instead. This was a field used for string
custom questions. We've since moved to structured custom questions in the
`QuestionAnswer` field.

email.description: Optional. The email address of the contributor

media.description: Optional. Array of media items to be linked to the incident.

site_id.description:
Optional. ID of the site to associate with the incident.
If not provided, no site will be associated with the incident.

name.description: Optional. The name of the contributor

contact.description: Optional. The contact details of the contributor

location.description: The location that the incident occurred at

access_token.description:
Optional. The access token used to authenticate the request. This field
should be set when following the contributor flow. Otherwise, authenticate
via normal means.

description.description: Optional. Description of the issue (maximum 500 characters).

questions_and_answers.description:
Optional. An array of all, if any, custom questions that have been answered
for this issue.

items.description:
Optional. The category fields and questions that applied to this incident
when it was created.

occurred_at.description: Optional. Date and time this incident occurred at

asset_id.description: Optional. The ID of the asset associated with this incident.

ai_generated.description:
Use `ai_marking`. True when this issue was created via an AI-assisted
flow, for example the QR-code AI Issue Creation flow seeded by
GenerateIncidentStream.

ai_marking.description:
Optional. The AI marking the caller declares for this issue, under the
write rules. A caller can set a flag true and cannot clear it, and false is
recorded as absent. Surfaces on Incident.ai_marking. The Assistant sets it
through the mitti-ai-marked header rather than this field.

s12.common.GeoPosition.description: A position is the fundamental geographical geometry construct.

filename.description: full file name, including file extension

s12.common.MediaType.description:
- MEDIA_TYPE_IMAGE: An image file (GIF, JPG, PNG, WEBP).
 - MEDIA_TYPE_VIDEO: A video file (MP4, MOV).
 - MEDIA_TYPE_PDF: A PDF document.
 - MEDIA_TYPE_DOCX: A Microsoft Word document (DOCX, DOC).
 - MEDIA_TYPE_XLSX: A Microsoft Excel spreadsheet (XLSX, XLS).
 - MEDIA_TYPE_PPTX: A Microsoft PowerPoint presentation (PPTX, PPT).
 - MEDIA_TYPE_CSV: A CSV file.

ai_edited.description:
True when something non deterministic, in practice an LLM, produced or
changed this content. False when no AI did, which includes content a person
wrote and content a deterministic path produced. Absent when the origin was
not recorded. Do not report false in place of absent.

human_edited.description:
True when a person authored or changed this content. False when no person
did, which includes content a model generated and content a deterministic
path produced. Absent when the origin was not recorded. Do not report false
in place of absent.

s12.common.v1.AiMarking.description:
AiMarking carries the AI marking fact on an API representation, so a machine
can read whether AI and whether a person produced or changed the content.
It is the read side of the express path: one shared message with standard
property names, rather than every domain inventing its own field for the
same fact.

Both fields are presence tracked. The three states each carry a different
meaning and must not be collapsed:

  true    The actor named by the field produced or changed this content.
  false   The actor named by the field is known not to have produced or
          changed this content. It is a claim about that actor only.
  absent  We did not record the origin.

false is not evidence that a deterministic path produced the content. Known
human only content can read ai_edited false, and known AI only content can
read human_edited false. Set a field to false only when you know it is false.
Leave it absent when you do not, so a consumer relying on the API for their
own obligation can tell "not true" from "not recorded". EU AI Act Article
50(2), engineering approach page.

text.description: The text that answers the question.

s12.tasks.v1.AnswerText.description: A type of answer for a custom question containing text data.

is_mandatory.description: Whether or not the item must be filled before submission

is_disabled.description: Whether or not the item is disabled and hidden from submission

s12.tasks.v1.Item.ItemType.description: - ITEM_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED: The item type is unspecified
s12.tasks.v1.Item.ItemType.title: The types of items

id.description: The UUID of the multiple choice option.

text.description:
The text of the multiple choice option. This does not use the new `validator.string` option as question processing
logic fails when symbols are substituted for similar-looking symbols.

s12.tasks.v1.MultipleChoiceOption.description: MultipleChoiceOption represents a possible answer for a multiple choice question.

s12.tasks.v1.MultipleChoiceOptions.description: MultipleChoiceOptions is an explicit message for a set of MultipleChoiceOption's to use in a oneof field below.

text.description:
The text of the question being asked (e.g. "How many eggs are in a dozen?"). This does not use the new
`validator.string` option as question processing logic fails when symbols are substituted for similar-looking
symbols.

type.description: The type of the question. See `enum QuestionType` for more details.

is_mandatory.description: Whether the question is mandatory or not

s12.tasks.v1.Question.description: Question represents the question structure for a custom question.

s12.tasks.v1.Question.QuestionType.description:
- QUESTION_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED: The question type is unspecified. This generally should not happen.
 - QUESTION_TYPE_TEXT: The question is text type. This question accepts freetext answers.
 - QUESTION_TYPE_MULTIPLE_CHOICE: The question is multiple choice. This question provides a list of options to choose from.
s12.tasks.v1.Question.QuestionType.title: The types of questions

question_id.description: The ID of the question being answered.

answer_text.description:
AnswerText indicates that the question being answered has a text
response.

answer_multiple_choice.description: MultipleChoiceOption indicates that the question being answered is a multiple choice question.

s12.tasks.v1.SubmitIncidentRequest.Quest.description:
QuestionAnswer contains data about a question configured for this issue's
category, as well as the answer to that question.

name.description: The name of the task's location.

s12.tasks.v1.Task.AddressLocation.description:
The location of the task.
The latitude and longitude in the `geo_position` object are required.
All other fields are optional, but add extra context to the location on
platform.
